text:
DearSQL 

 A simple, cross-platform database client built with Dear ImGui. 

 
 Download 
 

 
 
 

 

 Features

- SQLite, DuckDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra and more, plus S3-compatible object storage
- Cross-platform: macOS (Metal), Linux (GTK4 + OpenGL), Windows (DirectX 11)
- Schema browser, editable data grid, SQL editor with completion and syntax checks, charts, JSON view
- Query plans (Explain / Analyze) with warnings for full scans, repeated scans, big sorts and bad estimates
- AI agents in the app (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor) that read your schema and run queries, writing only after you approve
- Terminal client, MCP server and language server from the same binary

 Command line

The same binary runs in the terminal (docs):

 

 

A connection is a saved name, a URL, or a SQLite/DuckDB/CSV file.

 For coding agents

DearSQL gives an agent your saved connections (credentials stay encrypted in DearSQL, SSH tunnels included) as tools, with compact text results (docs):

 Tool 
 --- --- 
 search schema , describe table , list tables find tables and columns (fuzzy, typo-tolerant), then keys, indexes and foreign keys 
 run query one read-only statement, paged with a cursor 
 explain query the query plan plus warnings: full scans a filter mostly discards, scans repeated per join row, spilled sorts, bad estimates 
 review indexes foreign keys with no index, indexes another one covers 
 explain finding what a warning code means, how to confirm it, the usual fix 
 profile table per column: nulls, distinct values, min and max, the common values 
 diff schema the statements that would make one database's schema match another's 
 execute sql a change, approved by you first ( --allow-writes over MCP) 
 list objects , read object , ... S3 buckets and files 

The dearsql command has to be on your PATH: Settings → Command Line → Install 'dearsql' Command in the app, or the install script below.

 Claude Code : the plugin registers the MCP server and adds a skill that teaches the workflow (search before writing SQL, explain before suggesting an index, approve every write):

 

or only the MCP server: claude mcp add dearsql -- dearsql --mcp .

 Codex : register the server and add the skill to /.agents/skills :

 

 Anything else : any MCP client can run dearsql --mcp over stdio, and an agent with a shell can use the same tools as commands ( dearsql tools lists them). The skill in plugins/dearsql/skills/dearsql/SKILL.md works as a prompt for any of them.

install.html:
Download the latest release for macOS, Linux, and Windows from GitHub Releases, or on macOS/Linux:
